about: SealKeeper SEAL reader fixtures. Each case names its file, the command that checks it and the answer at each clock. A SEAL states the POST /v1/seal/verify answer against keys.json, a handshake the handshake field of that answer, a read the recorded answer. README.md says how to run them.

cases.name: v1-valid
cases.description: A version 1 SEAL issued an hour before FIXTURE_NOW. Valid then, and lapsed since.

commands.pinned: npx sealkeeper@latest seal verify - --keys fixtures/keys.json --at 2026-10-01T12:00:00Z < fixtures/seals/v1-valid.txt
commands.now: npx sealkeeper@latest seal verify - --keys fixtures/keys.json < fixtures/seals/v1-valid.txt

cases.name: v1-expired
cases.description: A version 1 SEAL that expired an hour before FIXTURE_NOW. Expired at either clock.

commands.pinned: npx sealkeeper@latest seal verify - --keys fixtures/keys.json --at 2026-10-01T12:00:00Z < fixtures/seals/v1-expired.txt
commands.now: npx sealkeeper@latest seal verify - --keys fixtures/keys.json < fixtures/seals/v1-expired.txt

cases.name: v1-bad-signature
cases.description: v1-valid with one character of the signature changed. The signature is checked before the time, so it is bad_signature at either clock.

commands.pinned: npx sealkeeper@latest seal verify - --keys fixtures/keys.json --at 2026-10-01T12:00:00Z < fixtures/seals/v1-bad-signature.txt
commands.now: npx sealkeeper@latest seal verify - --keys fixtures/keys.json < fixtures/seals/v1-bad-signature.txt

cases.name: v1-unknown-kid
cases.description: A version 1 SEAL signed by another test key under kid fixture-9, which keys.json does not list.

commands.pinned: npx sealkeeper@latest seal verify - --keys fixtures/keys.json --at 2026-10-01T12:00:00Z < fixtures/seals/v1-unknown-kid.txt
commands.now: npx sealkeeper@latest seal verify - --keys fixtures/keys.json < fixtures/seals/v1-unknown-kid.txt

cases.name: v4-valid
cases.description: A version 4 SEAL with a fingerprint, a Trust Score and top categories, issued an hour before FIXTURE_NOW.

commands.pinned: npx sealkeeper@latest seal verify - --keys fixtures/keys.json --at 2026-10-01T12:00:00Z < fixtures/seals/v4-valid.txt
commands.now: npx sealkeeper@latest seal verify - --keys fixtures/keys.json < fixtures/seals/v4-valid.txt

cases.name: handshake
cases.description: A handshake the fixture agent signed at FIXTURE_NOW over its fingerprint, with nonce fixture-nonce and verifier fixture-verifier, checked beside v4-valid.

commands.now: npx sealkeeper@latest seal verify - --keys fixtures/keys.json --at 2026-10-01T12:00:00Z --handshake "$(cat fixtures/handshake/handshake.txt)" --nonce fixture-nonce --for fixture-verifier < fixtures/seals/v4-valid.txt

cases.name: withheld
cases.description: SealKeeper holds the agent for cause, reason the class only.

cases.name: no_recent_check
cases.description: A listed agent with no recent OK task check. It is no hold.

cases.name: checking
cases.description: A listed agent SealKeeper is still checking, or one no longer listed.

cases.name: no_seal
cases.description: The SEAL is withheld because the agent has been dormant.

cases.name: renamed
cases.description: The handle route only. The handle was given up, and the agent is now at handle.

cases.name: validation_failed
cases.description: A malformed agent id. Fix the request rather than retry it.

cases.name: rate_limited
cases.description: Over the public read limit. Retry-After is the whole seconds to wait, and its value varies.
